data.title: Grant Cardone Says Commercial Real Estate Faces Historic Crash - Sees Bitcoin As A 'Complementary Asset'
data.description: Veteran real estate investor Grant Cardone said commercial real estate was heading into "almost Armageddon conditions," and that his answer was to put Bitcoin (BTC) on the balance sheet of every building he buys, what he called a "complementary asset.""Complete reset across the board of commercial…
